rounds.text: Cupid Breweries & Distilleries Ltd trades at a steep discount to its asset base, with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.40x on a book value of ₹ 72.1 per share [E1], which is further supported by a provider-reported P/B of 0.37x against a sector benchmark of 1.79x [E6]. This profound asset undervaluation provides a significant margin of safety for investors willing to look past temporary headwinds. Conceded: [E14], [E3], and [E48].
